class.name: DisRemoteEntity
class.brief_description: A remote entity created and moved by a [DisEntityManager].
class.description: A [Node3D] that represents one entity published by another simulation. [DisEntityManager] creates it when the first Entity State PDU of a new entity ID arrives, moves it every frame, and frees it when the entity is deactivated or times out. The scene chosen by the manager's [DisEntityTypeMap] is its child. The node's global transform follows the dead-reckoned (and smoothed, possibly ground-clamped) pose in scene coordinates. The values below come from the last Entity State PDU received. Do not create this class yourself.

method.name: get_appearance
method.description: Returns the entity appearance bit field from the last PDU (see SISO-REF-010), or 0 if there is none.

method.name: get_dr_algorithm
method.description: Returns the dead reckoning algorithm in use (0 to 9). It is 1 (static) when the manager's [member DisEntityManager.dead_reckoning] is off.

method.name: get_geodetic
method.description: Returns the dead-reckoned position as a [PackedFloat64Array] [code][latitude, longitude, height][/code]: latitude and longitude in degrees, height in metres above the WGS84 ellipsoid. It does not include smoothing or ground clamping.

method.name: get_last_pdu
method.description: Returns the last [DisEntityStatePdu] received for this entity.

method.name: get_last_update_time
method.description: Returns the time in seconds, on the manager's clock ([method DisEntityManager.get_clock]), at which the last PDU was applied.

method.name: get_location_ecef
method.description: Returns the dead-reckoned position as a [PackedFloat64Array] [code][x, y, z][/code] in geocentric (ECEF) coordinates, in metres, as of the last frame update. It does not include smoothing or ground clamping.

members.member: The entity ID as (site, application, entity number). Read-only.
The 7-field entity type (kind, domain, country, category, subcategory, specific, extra) from the last PDU. Read-only.
The force ID from the last PDU: 0 Other, 1 Friendly, 2 Opposing, 3 Neutral. Read-only.
The text marking from the last PDU. Read-only.
